ownership_rule: The examples database of this computer (data/qnc-shot-examples.db), outside every project: the corrections of the AI B-roll groups outlive the projects. qnc.module.shot-examples is its only writer.

rules.example: A row is one shot whose group the user corrected (user 2026-11-10): the model of its vector, its key (the project's public URI, the clip and the clip frames [from, to)), the group (a label's code, or none: no B-roll) and its vector.
rules.replace: A shot corrected again replaces its row; the rows of a model are compared only with vectors of that model.
rules.follow: A shot takes its own correction; else the group of the example most like it, from a cosine of 0.85 (a first estimate); else the labels decide.
